summary.label: The idea
summary.title: From saved inspiration to your next good meal.
summary.body: A recipe should be easy to find when you are ready to cook. Fovri brings shared links, editable recipes, meal plans and groceries together in one calm place.

features.title: Bring recipes into your cookbook
features.body: Share a recipe link to Fovri or paste it in the app. Review and edit the ingredients and steps; optional AI help can recover missing details or create a labelled suggestion from a video.

features.title: Plan meals and groceries
features.body: Choose what to cook next and bring the ingredients into a grocery list you can check off as you shop.

features.title: Cook at your own pace
features.body: Adjust servings, follow the steps and use cooking timers while keeping the original source within reach.

cta.title: Try Fovri for yourself.
cta.body: Take a closer look on the App Store.

footer.note: Available on the App Store. Five successful recipe imports are free; Fovri Pro offers monthly and yearly subscriptions for further imports. Saved recipes remain available without a subscription. Screenshots show sample content.
